raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Since #7988,  `CUDA_Accelerator` opens NVTX domain ranges with `nvtx.get_domain(name).push_range(message=...)` , which only exists in `nvtx >= 0.2.15`. With an older nvtx installed, every CUDA training run crashes on the first ` engine.forward` , at any ZeRO stage.
Rather than `pinning  nvtx>=0.2.15`  and forcing users onto the newest releases, this PR passes the domain name to nvtx's module-level  `push_range / pop_range`, which work on both old and new releases (tested 0.2.10 - 0.2.16). The recorded ranges are unchanged.

detail.body:
Since #7988,  `CUDA_Accelerator` opens NVTX domain ranges with `nvtx.get_domain(name).push_range(message=...)` , which only exists in `nvtx >= 0.2.15`. With an older nvtx installed, every CUDA training run crashes on the first ` engine.forward` , at any ZeRO stage.
Rather than `pinning  nvtx>=0.2.15`  and forcing users onto the newest releases, this PR passes the domain name to nvtx's module-level  `push_range / pop_range`, which work on both old and new releases (tested 0.2.10 - 0.2.16). The recorded ranges are unchanged.
detail.title: Use nvtx's module-level API so NVTX domain ranges work on older nvtx releases

files.patch:
@@ -89,13 +89,15 @@ class FakeNvtx:
         def __init__(self):
             self.domains = {}
 
-        def get_domain(self, name):
-            self.domains.setdefault(name, FakeDomain())
-            return self.domains[name]
+        def push_range(self, message=None, domain=None, category=None):
+            fake_domain = self.domains.setdefault(domain, FakeDomain())
+            return fake_domain.push_range(message=message, category=category)
+
+        def pop_range(self, domain=None):
+            return self.domains[domain].pop_range()
 
     fake_nvtx = FakeNvtx()
     accelerator = CUDA_Accelerator.__new__(CUDA_Accelerator)
-    accelerator._nvtx_domains = {}
     monkeypatch.setattr(cuda_accelerator, "nvtx", fake_nvtx)
 
     assert accelerator.range_push("my_range", domain="DeepSpeed", category="zero") == "domain-push"
